content.title: Paradise season 2 release schedule – how to watch new episodes
content.text: *Warning: This article contains spoilers for episodes 1-4 of Paradise season 2.*Coming into the second season of Paradise, as well as our main players returning for more, we knew that new characters played by Shailene Woodley and Thomas Doherty would prove to game changers for the episodes ahead.While we've followed Xavier (Sterling K Brown) on his quest to find his wife, we have also got a window into how the world has continued on in the face of the natural disaster, through the eyes of Annie (Woodley).That's why it makes it all the more heartbreaking that this week's episode has delivered quite the fatal twist for the character. Speaking about the fourth episode, Woodley told The Hollywood Reporter: "It’s so profoundly and poignantly written, that reading it in and of itself evoked every emotion that we needed to bring it alive on the day."I credit the writers who are so brilliant and so in touch with their own humanity, which made our jobs a lot more seamless."This only continues to throw more spanners in the works for not just Xavier, but the series which really is taking us on every twist and turn imaginable. With an outside world that has continued whirring after the worst natural disaster ever, Xavier has already started to see just what remains but as for whether it'll get him any closer to finding his wife, we'll just have to see.But when do new episodes of Paradise land on Disney+? Read on to find out.When are new episodes of Paradise season 2 released?Julianne Nicholson and Nicole Brydon Bloom in Paradise season 2. Disney/Gilles MingassonParadise season 2 premiered on Monday 23 February with its first three episodes, with further episodes airing weekly. That means you'll want to set a reminder each Monday to make sure you keep up-to-date with new instalments!New episodes of Paradise season 2 land on Disney+ in the UK and on Hulu in the US.The full release schedule for the second season of Paradise can be found below, with episodes landing every Monday.Episode 1 - Graceland - Monday 23 February (out now)Episode 2 - Mayday - Monday 23 February (out now)Episode 3 - Another Day in Paradise - Monday 23 February (out now)Episode 4 - A Holy Charge - Monday 2 March (out now)Episode 5 - The Mailman - Monday 9 MarchEpisode 6 - Jane - Monday 16 MarchEpisode 7 - The Final Countdown - Monday 23 MarchEpisode 8 - Exodus - Monday 30 MarchHow many episodes of Paradise season 2 are there?There are eight episodes in the second season of Paradise, just like the show's premiere season.Paradise season 2 trailerThe trailer for Paradise season 2 can be found below.Paradise season 2 is streaming exclusively on Disney+, with new episodes available weekly.Check out more of our Drama coverage or visit our TV Guide and Streaming Guide to find out what's on. For more TV recommendations and reviews, listen to The Radio Times Podcast.AuthorsMorgan Cormack is a Drama Writer for Radio Times, covering everything drama-related on TV and streaming.
